verified_properties: One persistent queue.lock serializes ticket registration and admission; tickets are ordered by registration.
Ticket liveness uses OS flock ownership; killed queued/admitted processes and crash between ticket creation and locking permit successor progress.
Cancellation/deadline paths release selected capacity and remove owned tickets, including cancellation immediately after registration or claim.
Only admission is serialized; independent processes can occupy all four configured slots.
Cross-thread and cross-process late arrivals cannot overtake a registered older waiter.

limitations: FIFO means successful ticket registration order, not exact simultaneous call-start order.
The short mutex itself is not proven starvation-free.
All replay processes must use the new implementation and the same configured concurrency limit.
Passing offline checks does not establish live cohort success or prevent legitimate deadline exhaustion.
The earlier 50 ms version passed 13 fairness cases but failed the broader existing parallelism regression; that failure remains preserved.
